title: Governed catalog, member offers, benchmark display and sales windows
claims: Sales-window configuration requires canonical authority, not UI/admin access.
Member catalog views require an active listing, executable bounded offer and open governed sales window.
Displayed benchmark values retain governed benchmark version and evidence lineage and must be comparable to the offered specification, quantity and place.
Underlying offer validity does not silently override a closed sales window.
